name: Sculpfun iCube Pro 5W
tagline: 5W Compact enclosed Sculpfun : small footprint, full safety cabinet
tldr: Sculpfun iCube Pro 5W is the 5W SKU on the Sculpfun sculpfun icube pro line. Sculpfun's enclosed desktop laser for makers who want the brand's cutting performance in a safer cabinet. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal : occasional thin cuts only

priceRange.note: 5W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 5W Compact enclosed Sculpfun : small footprint, full safety cabinet
Fully enclosed cabinet : beam containment and smoke control vs open-frame diodes
Work area 300 × 300 mm on this chassis
5W on Sculpfun iCube Pro: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~18–28 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~9–15 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 3 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Higher modules in this line (10W) add cut speed and depth
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 3 mm+ stock all day
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 5W module on Sculpfun iCube Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed
